service.name: Client dinner and member event entertainment
service.serviceType: Live music for client dinners, member events and private clubs
service.description: Jazz duo and small ensembles for client dinners, member events and private clubs in Denver, played at conversation volume with sound support that's the right size for the venue.

faqs.q: How loud is a jazz duo during dinner?
faqs.a: About the level of the conversation at the table, so your guests talk across it without raising their voices, and the duo holds that level all evening. If your venue or club enforces a sound cap, give us the number when we sign and the evening is built under it.

faqs.q: Can you invoice against a purchase order?
faqs.a: Yes. We can be set up as a vendor and quote against a PO, with the purchase order number on one itemized invoice: performance, sound and any travel on separate lines. The certificate of insurance, at the limits Colorado clubs and hotels write into their vendor requirements, and the W-9 come with the contract. Vendor onboarding is usually the slowest step, so start it when you shortlist.

faqs.q: How much space does the duo need?
faqs.a: A corner of about 8 by 6 feet, one dedicated 20-amp circuit, and an hour to set up, which can run through a service corridor. No stage and no house sound system are needed. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with 15 to 20 minutes between them, and music continues through the breaks.
